title: The Sample Complexity of Distributed Simple Binary Hypothesis Testing under Information Constraints
abstract: arXiv:2506.13686v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: This paper resolves two open problems from a recent paper, arXiv:2403.16981, concerning the sample complexity of distributed simple binary hypothesis testing under information constraints. The first open problem asks whether interaction reduces the sample complexity of distributed simple binary hypothesis testing. In this paper, we show that sequential interaction does not help. The second problem suggests tightening existing sample complexity bounds for communication-constrained simple binary hypothesis testing. We derive optimally tight bounds for this setting and resolve this problem. Our main technical contributions are: (i) a one-shot lower bound on the Bayes error in simple binary hypothesis testing that satisfies a crucial tensorisation property; (ii) a streamlined proof of the formula for the sample complexity of simple binary hypothesis testing without constraints, first established in arXiv:2403.16981; and (iii) a rev

translated_title: 信息约束下分布式简单二元假设检验的样本复杂度
translated_abstract: 本文解决了最近一篇论文（arXiv:2403.16981）中关于信息约束下分布式简单二元假设检验样本复杂度的两个开放问题。第一个开放问题询问交互是否能降低分布式简单二元假设检验的样本复杂度。在本文中，我们证明了顺序交互没有帮助。第二个问题建议收紧通信约束下简单二元假设检验的现有样本复杂度界。我们为该设置推导出了最优紧致的界，从而解决了这一问题。我们的主要技术贡献包括：(i) 简单二元假设检验中贝叶斯误差的一个单次（one-shot）下界，该下界满足一个关键的张量化性质；(ii) 对无约束情形下简单二元假设检验样本复杂度公式（最初由 arXiv:2403.16981 建立）的简化证明；(iii) 一个 rev
tldr: 本文解决了信息约束下分布式简单二元假设检验的两个开放问题，证明顺序交互无法降低样本复杂度，并给出了通信约束下样本复杂度的最优紧致界。
en_tdlr: This paper resolves two open problems in distributed simple binary hypothesis testing under information constraints, showing that sequential interaction does not help reduce sample complexity and deriving optimally tight bounds for the communication-constrained setting.
